Uttar Pradesh.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
Uttar Pradesh.description: Provides financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly into the bank accounts of farmers.

Uttar Pradesh.name: UP Pankaj Kisan Uday Yojana
Uttar Pradesh.description: Provides solar-powered energy-efficient pumps to farmers, reducing irrigation expenses.
Uttar Pradesh.eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with access to water sources.
Uttar Pradesh.benefits: Subsidized solar pump sets (up to 70% subsidy).

Uttar Pradesh.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
Uttar Pradesh.description: Provides short-term timely credit to farmers for crop cultivation and maintenance.
Uttar Pradesh.eligibility: All farmers, owner cultivators, sharecroppers, tenant farmers.
Uttar Pradesh.benefits: Loans up to ₹3 Lakhs at subsidized interest rates of 4% per annum.

Bihar.name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahayata Yojana
Bihar.description: Provides financial aid to farmers in the event of crop loss due to natural calamities like drought or floods.
Bihar.eligibility: Registered farmers in Bihar who face >20% crop damage.

Bihar.name: Bihar Diesel Anudan Yojana
Bihar.description: Offers subsidy on diesel for irrigating crops during dry spells and droughts.
Bihar.eligibility: Registered Bihar farmers performing diesel-powered pump irrigation.
Bihar.benefits: Subsidy of ₹75 per liter for diesel, up to limit of ₹750/acre.

Punjab.name: Punjab Crop Diversification Scheme
Punjab.description: Encourages farmers to shift from paddy cultivation to other crops like maize, pulses, and oilseeds to conserve groundwater.
Punjab.benefits: Financial incentives, free seed distribution, and guaranteed MSP for alternative crops.

Punjab.name: Punjab Debt Waiver Scheme
Punjab.description: Provides relief to small and marginal farmers by waiving agricultural loans up to a certain limit.
Punjab.eligibility: Small/marginal farmers with landholdings up to 5 acres.
Punjab.benefits: Loan waiver of up to ₹2 Lakhs.

Maharashtra.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
Maharashtra.description: A state-level scheme matching the PM-Kisan scheme, providing additional financial support.
Maharashtra.benefits: Additional ₹6,000 per year (total of ₹12,000 including PM-Kisan).

Maharashtra.name: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Pond Scheme)
Maharashtra.description: Assists farmers in digging farm ponds to secure water supply for crops during dry spells.
Maharashtra.eligibility: Farmers with at least 0.60 hectares of land.
Maharashtra.benefits: Subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for digging ponds.

Tamil Nadu.name: TN Free Electricity Scheme for Agriculture
Tamil Nadu.description: Provides free, uninterrupted electrical power to agricultural pump sets to reduce irrigation overheads.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Landholding farmers with authorized agricultural service connections.

Tamil Nadu.name: Kuruvai Special Packages
Tamil Nadu.description: Provides subsidized inputs (fertilizers, seeds, micro-nutrients) for the Kuruvai crop season in the Cauvery delta.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Farmers in the Cauvery delta districts.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on agricultural inputs.
